title: QUADRIGA Data Literacy Framework
description: The QUADRIGA data literacy framework additionally aims to promote scientific integrity and reflective thinking. It seeks to support an inherently open attitude (in line with the guiding principle of being as open as possible and as closed as necessary) towards the sharing and reuse of research data. To achieve this, the necessary skills are taught at every step of the data-based research process (see data flow).

orientation.title: Conceptual knowledge
orientation.text: Prior knowledge of basic concepts of research data management and Open X, as well as knowledge of areas of application for data, are helpful.
orientation.note: The conceptual knowledge (Orientierungswissen) lies outside the data flow and the individual competencies; it forms the foundation for all phases.

competencies.title: Identification
competencies.knowledge: Types of data sources; search and retrieval techniques
competencies.examples: Query languages, data portals, research data centers, repositories

competencies.title: Quality assurance
competencies.skills: Independent evaluation of data quality following defined criteria

competencies.title: Ethics and legal aspects
competencies.skills: Ethical and legally compliant (re-)use of data
competencies.examples: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), good research practice

competencies.title: Acquisition
competencies.knowledge: Methods and tools for data collection and acquisition

competencies.title: Validation
competencies.skills: Identification and remediation of data errors and gaps

competencies.title: (Pre-)processing
competencies.knowledge: Data formats; conversion methods; data cleaning

competencies.title: Organisation
competencies.knowledge: Methods, standards, and tools for data and project management
competencies.skills: Development of organisational processes, structures, and governance
competencies.examples: Role allocation, versioning, management systems, data management plan

competencies.title: Metadata
competencies.knowledge: Methods and tools for data description; metadata standards
competencies.skills: Selection and application of appropriate standards, description languages, and vocabularies
competencies.examples: Annotation, enrichment, (domain-specific) standards, subject classifications, metadata schemas

competencies.title: Data analysis
competencies.knowledge: Methods and tools for data analysis
competencies.skills: Selection and application of appropriate analytical methods, processes, and tools

competencies.title: Visualisation
competencies.knowledge: Methods and tools for data visualisation
competencies.skills: Selection and application of adequate visualisations

competencies.title: Interpretation
competencies.knowledge: Significance and limitations of data analyses and their interdependencies
competencies.skills: Systematic inference of evidence-based conclusions and forecasts

competencies.title: Preservation
competencies.knowledge: Requirements and methods for data preservation
competencies.skills: Appraisal of retention value of data; selection of appropriate standards and trustworthy repositories
competencies.examples: Data and format migration, digital long-term preservation, access control

competencies.title: Data publication
competencies.knowledge: Methods and platforms for data publication and sharing for reuse
competencies.skills: Ethical, legal, and standard-compliant data publication and sharing

competencies.title: Communication
competencies.knowledge: Methods and strategies of other scholarly publication formats as well as scholarly and science communication
competencies.skills: Audience-specific synthesis and communication of research findings
competencies.examples: Data storytelling, forms of outreach, forms of publication
